mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in FEDFUNDS over the prior quarter signals monetary tightening, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5% over prior quarter, or Rank IC > 0.05 over 3-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 3.5% in one month signals heightened labor cost pressures, leading to inflationary expectations and negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive despite UNRATE exceeding 3.5% in > 50% of triggered instances, or t-test p-value > 0.05 showing no significant negative relationship.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward trends in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) indicate robust demand-driven economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises > 2% and INDPRO rises > 1% over prior month
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative despite both proxies rising above thresholds, or IC < 0.03 over 1-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in HOUST (demand) over the prior month signals stronger consumer activity, driving corporate profits and equity appreciation, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: HOUST does not rise consistently over prior month or 20d returns are negative despite sustained demand growth.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), elevated rates reduce discount rates on future cash flows, compressing equity valuations and causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS >4.5%, or IC >0.05 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising INDPRO (supply) alongside falling UNRATE (labor costs) indicates strong economic growth with controlled inflation, fostering investor optimism and positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 1% and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp over prior month
failure_condition: 60d returns negative despite both proxies moving in predicted directions, or IC <0.03 over 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in PAYEMS above 152,000 in one month signals robust labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not exceed 152,000 or 5d returns are negative despite the employment spike.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS (monetary tightening) and decline in UNRATE (lower inflation expectations) creates a stabilizing signal, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% and UNRATE falls > 0.3pp over prior month
failure_condition: 20d returns negative despite both proxies moving in predicted directions, or IC <0.03 over 6-month window.
